about: Golden vectors for casino/rlwheel.js (the shared roulette wheel: site test test/casino-rlwheel.test.js and the bot's obs_casino_scene_test). Each case: plan({tableId, round, pocket, startedAt, landAt = startedAt + D}). k[pocket] = whole pockets the rotor is shown shifted; s = the idle rotor's slot the ball settles in (pocket-independent); ball = FNV-1a over the Float32 bytes of the frames' r/theta/z columns; samples = [t - landAt, rotor, r, theta, z, phase(0 idle,1 track,2 cone,3 rotor,4 settled)] for the case's own pocket. Regenerate only when the model changes on purpose (bump VERSION): RLWHEEL_WRITE_VECTORS=1 node --test test/casino-rlwheel.test.js
